operation_preflight: Reject unresolved draw operations before Vulkan submission.
Reject Copy/Convert operations missing source or destination extent/base/pitch.
Require complete, unique, ordered draw references and strictly increasing packet ordinals.
Retain each Copy/Convert packet's own raw source registers and compiled shaders; reject unresolved or unprepared copy payloads before submission.
changes.ordered_executor: The plugin routes captured operations to a Vulkan queue-order executor. Same-layout color/depth targets persist between segments; copy-only execution may use an exact cached source layout. A later draw can sample an intermediate format-31 image only for a matching linear base-level descriptor and complete copy tuple. The complete retail package remains blocked by layout aliasing, clear/depth preservation, and unmatched tiled mip texture descriptors.
changes.texture_descriptor: Prepared textures retain guest address/layout metadata. For a preceding format-31 copy with exact base, pitch, height, format 31, number format 7, endian 2, sample 0, no array/slice/swizzle/gamma conversion, a linear non-mip texture fetch binds the GPU image directly and skips stale guest RAM reads. Other layouts remain fail-closed.
changes.copy_convert_primitives: Added standalone Vulkan output paths for captured format-26 all-four-sample conversion and format-31 sample-zero copies (1x and 4x sources), plus GPU-resident destination images cached by guest address and complete captured layout. Repeated submissions reuse the target with exact readback; see process2_copy_convert_primitives_20261027.json.
changes.interrupt_trace: With ring tracing enabled, each PM4_INTERRUPT record includes generation, batch read/write pointers, ring guest address, expanded packet ordinal, source IB and byte offset, requested/dispatched CPU masks, and per-asserted-CPU callback guest address, callback data, and dispatch status.

limits: These changes improve operation validation and trace observability. They do not establish rendered parity, video-transition success, guest synchronization correctness, or Android renderer readiness.
